name: InventisBio Co., Limited
summary: InventisBio Co., Limited, a clinical stage biotech company, focuses on areas of oncology, autoimmune diseases, and metabolic disorders to address unmet medical needs in China. Its product pipeline for the oncology therapeutic area include Befoternitib (BPI-D0316), which is in Phase III clinical trial for the non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLS) indications; Garsorasib (D-1553), which is in phase II and III clinical trials to treat NSCLS and colorectal cancer; Taragarestrant (D-0502), which is in phase III and II to treat estrogen receptor positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-breast cancer.
